newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real drops 0.04 pct in calm trading.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real drops 0.04 pct in calm trading.

text.p: Brazil's real dropped 0.04 percent to close at 1.0429 per dollar in the commercial foreign exchange market on dollar buying ahead of next week's Martin Luther King Day holiday in the U.S., dealers said.
Due to the holiday, transactions made today will be settled on Tuesday instead of Monday, making today a good day to buy and hold dollars, dealers added.
Also, banks that sold dollars yesterday to take advantage of arbitrage gains from holding reais over the long holiday weekend had to buy dollars today to cover their transactions, traders said.
Despite the real's fall, preliminary figures for commercial and financial foreign exchange contracts showed a Thursday surplus of $30 million.
In the floating exchange rate market, the real ended flat at 1.0482 per dollar. In the illegal parallel market, the real closed steady at 1.100 to the greenback, traders said.
